questions.question: The manager, who had been working late, was still at his desk when I left.
options: It was the manager who had been working late
Because he had been working late
Although he had been working late
When he had been working late
questions.answer: It was the manager who had been working late

questions.question: I would have finished my project on time if I hadn't encountered so many technical difficulties.
options: If I hadn't encountered so many technical difficulties, I wouldn't have finished my project
Because I encountered so many technical difficulties, I didn't finish my project
Even though I encountered many technical difficulties, I managed to finish the project
I would have finished my project on time even if I had encountered technical difficulties
questions.answer: If I hadn't encountered so many technical difficulties, I wouldn't have finished my project

questions.question: By the time we arrived at the party, it was already over.
options: When we arrived at the party, it had already been over
As soon as we arrived at the party, it was still going on
The moment we arrived at the party, it ended
We were too late for the party because it was already over
questions.answer: By the time we arrived at the party, it was already over

questions.question: It is essential that all employees undergo regular training to stay up-to-date with industry developments.
options: All employees need to be trained regularly
Employees should receive regular training
Training for employees is crucial
That all employees are trained regularly is a requirement
questions.answer: It is essential that all employees undergo regular training to stay up-to-date with industry developments

questions.question: The new policy, which has been met with widespread criticism, will be reviewed in six months.
options: The new policy has received a lot of criticism
Because the new policy has been criticized, it will be reviewed soon
The review of the new policy is scheduled for six months' time
Although the new policy has been criticized, it won't be reviewed until next year
questions.answer: The new policy, which has been met with widespread criticism, will be reviewed in six months
